predeclared_comparison.quantity: (AMR error at 0.003 - AMR error at 0.002) - (uniform error at 0.003 - uniform error at 0.002)
predeclared_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive excess error growth across the interval containing the first mesh refinement, relative to same-grid non-AMR evolution.
predeclared_comparison.logical_boundary: The 0.003 AMR checkpoint includes one solved timestep after remapping. A positive contrast does not isolate interpolation, flux correction, pressure projection, sensor changes, or post-remap evolution and is not evidence of an upstream defect.

acceptance.run_completion: Both cases must reach all three checkpoints with exit code zero and one converged outer-corrector record per step.
acceptance.quality_gate: No new acceptance threshold is defined; this is a diagnostic contrast, not a quality pass/fail or defect reproduction.

scope_limits: Two short n=16 runs do not establish an asymptotic AMR trend.
The first post-refinement checkpoint is after one solved timestep, not an instantaneous pre/post mapping pair.
Nonuniform-grid gradient and spectrum quality are outside this probe.
